summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — DSY.PA +4%, RNO.PA +3%, STAN.L +3%, STLAP.PA +3%, PRX.AS +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (SU.PA -10%, III.L -6%, BTRW.L -3%, BBY.L -2%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: SU.PA (-9.97%) — Schneider Electric agreed to buy US software maker PTC for $22.6B cash (42% premium, funded by €5-6B new equity plus heavy debt); investors sold on price, leverage and a ~5-year payback. Articles date the drop to Oct 5. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: SU.PA is a large-cap Euronext Paris industrial and the universe does not cover it. It was also an M&A-announcement gap-down, which momentum and mean-reversion filters would reject.

top_movers.catalyst: No clear company news catalyst found; likely a continued oversold software rebound (+3.7% on Oct 5 too), stock ~29% below its 52-week high, ahead of Q3 results on Oct 28.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: DSY.PA is a Paris-listed large-cap software name that no strategy includes. With no news catalyst, a news-reactive bot had nothing to trigger on, and the move looks like a sector rebound.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a liquid EU large-cap tech/software basket (DSY.PA, SAP.DE, CAP.PA) to the mean-reversion universe, using a trigger such as ≥25% below the 52-week high plus two consecutive up days.

top_movers.catalyst: No clear driver found. Renault named Michelin's Carine Damois as CFO and talked up €10B+ of French EV investment, but one source had the stock down ~1% midday, so the +3.08% close is unexplained.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: Renault is a mid-cap (~€7.3B) French autos name that no strategy includes. With no hard catalyst, a late-session drift up would not trip a news-reactive or gap-up trigger anyway.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change. Adding a mid-cap EU autos sleeve to the momentum universe for a one-day move with no catalyst isn't justified. The conflicting price data (prior close 25.42 vs. close 25.44) should be checked first.

top_movers.catalyst: No clear news catalyst: only routine items (VCC wealth fund launch, ongoing buyback). Stock was ~+0.2% at 15:50 London, so the +2.83% close likely came from a late-session rally in banks or the FTSE.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: STAN.L is a FTSE 100 large-cap bank that no strategy includes. With no news catalyst and a late-day move, a gap-up or news-reactive filter would not have triggered even if it were included.
top_movers.suggestion: Add FTSE 100 financials like STAN.L to the momentum-trader universe, with an intraday relative-strength trigger (e.g. +2% vs sector by 15:00 UK on ≥1.2× average volume). Alternatively accept this as a no-op: it was a sector move with no news catalyst.

top_movers.catalyst: Stellantis rebounded from record lows after the CEO reaffirmed 2026 guidance and Q3 US sales came in roughly flat with YTD up 3%. No fresh same-day news found; this looks like a relief bounce.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe. It is a large-cap, but a low-priced (~€4) auto name near all-time lows, so a price floor or downtrend/quality filter likely excluded it. The +2.77% move was a modest bounce with no gap or volume signal.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change. A bounce off record lows in a downtrending stock is a poor momentum fit. If wanted, add a mean-reversion watchlist rule for large-caps down >50% from the 52-week high that rise ≥2.5% on volume ≥1.5× average.

top_movers.catalyst: No clear company-specific catalyst found; Prosus rose 2.75% to 35.45 on routine buyback updates and a broad Dutch market rise. Search results didn't confirm the daily move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: PRX.AS is a large-cap Amsterdam-listed internet/tech holding company (Tencent proxy) that no strategy includes. A +2.75% drift with no news would also fail gap, volume and news filters.
top_movers.suggestion: (No actionable change.) A diffuse +2.75% move with no catalyst doesn't justify widening the universe. If wanted, add large-cap AEX/Euro Stoxx names like PRX.AS to the momentum universe, but only with a ≥1.5× volume gate.

top_movers.catalyst: Likely Ithaca Energy's deal to buy Suncor's Terra Nova and White Rose stakes offshore Canada ($860M upfront, up to $250M contingent). A search snippet put the shares near 283.8p, close to today's 282p close, but the article date wasn't confirmed.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: ITH.L is a mid-cap UK North Sea oil & gas producer that no strategy lists. The +2.4% move was a modest, announcement-driven gap, so a news-reactive or momentum filter wouldn't have fired even if the name were in scope.
top_movers.suggestion: Add mid-cap LSE energy producers (e.g. ITH.L) to the news-reactive strategy's universe, with an M&A-announcement trigger that enters on a ≥+2% gap with volume ≥1.5× average. Don't loosen the global momentum filters.

top_movers.catalyst: Schneider Electric agreed to buy US software maker PTC for $22.6B cash (42% premium, funded by €5-6B new equity plus heavy debt); investors sold on price, leverage and a ~5-year payback. Articles date the drop to Oct 5.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: SU.PA is a large-cap Euronext Paris industrial and the universe does not cover it. It was also an M&A-announcement gap-down, which momentum and mean-reversion filters would reject.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a liquid-large-cap EU watchlist (e.g. market cap >€50B) to the news-reactive strategy, with an acquirer-gap rule: flag gap-downs ≤-7% on volume ≥2× average that coincide with an M&A headline. Run it as a long-only mean-reversion check, since we have no short capability.

top_movers.catalyst: Likely continued de-rating on worries about softening growth at Action, 3i's largest holding (France like-for-like +0.9%, recent LFL about 3%). I found no specific 2026-10-06 headline, so this is partly inferred.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: III.L is a FTSE 100 listed private-equity/investment trust whose value is driven by one holding (Action). It is probably excluded as a financial or investment-trust name, and the bot has no short capability for a -6% drop.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change for the long-only bot. If coverage of UK-listed holding companies is wanted, add III.L to a news-reactive universe and flag single-asset NAV names when a >5% down-gap comes with elevated volume.

top_movers.catalyst: No clear company-specific catalyst found. Today's only news was routine (new CEO share award, ongoing £386m buyback). Likely a UK housebuilder sector move on margin and rate worries, not confirmed.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BTRW.L is a FTSE 100 UK housebuilder (large cap) that no strategy includes. A -3% sector-driven drift with no news or gap would also fail news-reactive and gap filters.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a UK housebuilders/cyclicals basket (BTRW.L, PSN.L, TW.L) to the mean-reversion universe, entered when the sector drops ≥2.5% on no stock-specific RNS.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst. Search found only routine buyback disclosures for Balfour Beatty, and a German quote showed it flat intraday. The -2.35% looks like a technical or sector move.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BBY.L is a UK mid-cap (FTSE 250-class) construction and infrastructure name. A -2.35% drift on no news is too small for gap or news-reactive triggers, and it would be a long-only bot's short or avoid case.
top_movers.suggestion: No actionable change. This was a small, news-free drift in an out-of-universe mid-cap, so widening the uk-eu universe to catch it would add noise. If wanted, add a UK mid-cap infrastructure watchlist with a ≥3% move and ≥1.5× volume gate.
